findings: hub mid-band fixes SM_OUT 14.9->5.2, KV_DESC 14.9->5.2, VM_HUB 15.2->6.1, HBM_VM 26.1->16.4 vs published v8; full mid (core at 2) trades them for rings (VM_RING 21, COLL_EP 31.6) -> core at 3 + COLL at inner end is best (bit-weighted 5.40 vs v8 5.99 at the same SM height)

AREA: with H-SM packed SM columns (7.14 mm2/SM single, 5.95 mm2/SM as pairs) v8b is 724 / 651 mm2 vs 660 -> NO real area gain; the 449 mm2 figure assumed a 2.85 mm2 SM that cannot be built (leaf outlines alone 3.45 mm2/SM)
centre column between the IDX scorers is mostly empty (~5 x 10 mm) in every v8 variant: a further shrink lever (scorer stack re-arrangement) if v8 is pursued
recommendation: Keep 660 (v5 envelope) as the die of record; v8b is routable and shortens wires, but at measured SM sizes it does not shrink the die (pair 651 mm2 = -1.4 %). v8b-pair is the candidate if the owner values -14 % die wirelength/SM_HBM 0 stages over re-planning risk.
